name: Turbobit
description: Resolves Turbobit links as a guest through the site's captcha and countdown, or with an account.

account.secret_hint: The password of the Turbobit account named above. rDownloader signs in itself and keeps the session; the password only ever reaches app.turbobit.net. Without an account, links are downloaded as a guest, with the site's captcha and countdown.
account.username_hint: The e-mail address the Turbobit account signs in with.

codes.turbobit.account_banned: Turbobit reports this account as banned
codes.turbobit.account_missing: Turbobit account or password is missing
codes.turbobit.folder_not_file: This Turbobit link is a folder; add the files it contains instead
codes.turbobit.free_limit_reached: Turbobit free download limit reached for this IP address; another download is possible in {wait_seconds}s
codes.turbobit.login_captcha: Turbobit did not accept the sign-in's captcha answer; it is retried later
codes.turbobit.login_failed: Turbobit rejected the account's e-mail address or password
codes.turbobit.no_direct_link: Turbobit did not hand out a download link
codes.turbobit.not_signed_in: Turbobit refused the request as not signed in
codes.turbobit.premium_limit_reached: Turbobit handed out no download link to the premium account; the daily limit may be reached
codes.turbobit.premium_only: Turbobit offers this file to premium accounts only
codes.turbobit.rate_limited: Turbobit rate limit reached; the request is retried later
